# situation: on pull_request_review_comment, the job runs ./deploy.sh with
#   secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN only if contains('alice bob', the commenter's
#   login) holds.
# reason: any login that is a part of 'alice bob', such as ali, passes the
#   if, and anyone with such a login can comment on the diff of a pull
#   request from a branch of the repository, whose run has the secrets.
# attack-value: github.event.comment.user.login = "ali"
# attack-run-behavior: a comment by the account ali on the diff of a pull
#   request whose branch is in the repository starts the job deploy;
#   contains('alice bob', 'ali') is true, so ./deploy.sh runs with TOKEN
#   set to DEPLOY_TOKEN's value.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  deploy:
    if: contains('alice bob', github.event.comment.user.login)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh
        env:
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
